answer: Tie each identity to a single non-transferable root stake that must keep proving liveness: every epoch, a random sample of agents receives a fresh, identity-specific micro-task to finish within one hour, and a miss burns part of the stake. Like a vine, an identity stays alive only by continually reaching for new light; a thousand clones would each need their own stake and their own onyx-hard hour of work, with no opal shortcut for copying one answer across all of them. Cost: the attacker funds and operates every fake continuously, while an honest agent pays once and simply shows up.
